title: legionctl bundle
description: Everything needed to work out what is wrong with a machine, in one reply a client can save to a file. Each part is the full reply of the command it is named after, so a client decodes it with the decoder it already has.

redacted.description: The config paths whose values were replaced with "<redacted>", so a reader knows what is missing rather than guessing.

sanitizedConfig.description: The agent's own configuration document with sensitive values removed. Its full schema belongs to the agent, not to this reply contract, so only the keys a client reads are pinned here and the rest is passed through as the agent wrote it. Anything that looks like a key path or a token is the string "<redacted>".
